question: Choose the antonym of 'commendable":
solution:
The correct answer is: **Blameworthy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"commendable"** means deserving praise or approval; something worthy of admiration. (सराहनीय)

 
 
• **Example:** Her dedication to helping the underprivileged is truly commendable.
 
 
 
• **"Blameworthy"** refers to something deserving of blame or criticism; something that is not praiseworthy. (दोष के योग्य)
 
 
• **Example:** His negligent behavior during the project was blameworthy.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **"commendable"** is **"blameworthy"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Blameworthy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Notable** (उल्लेखनीय): Worthy of attention or notice; significant.

 
 
• **Example:** The scientist made notable contributions to the field of genetics.
 
 
 
• **Laudable** (प्रशंसनीय): Worthy of praise and admiration.
 
 
• **Example:** Her efforts to raise awareness about environmental issues are laudable.
 
 
 
• **Admirable** (आदरणीय): Inspiring approval, respect, or affection.
 
 
• **Example:** His courage in the face of adversity is admirable.
